title: Correctness and running time of modular polynomial multiplication
preamble:
import Definitions.Def_ExpandingCodes_PolynomialStretch_BinaryRuntime

set_option autoImplicit false

open scoped Classical
open NKtLB
formal_statement:
theorem ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldArithmetic.multiply_stops {R B : ℕ} (r : Fin 27 → Fin R) (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (inp : Inputs) (ell : ℕ) (h : 0 < ell) (m a b : Fin (2^ell))
    (M : ℕ) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (d : ExpandingCodes.Computation.TapeStore R B) (hd : ∀ j, d.reg j ≤ M)
    (ha : d.reg (r 0) = a.val) (hb : d.reg (r 1) = b.val)
    (hm : d.reg (r 3) = 2^ell+m.val) (hN : d.reg (r 19) = 3*ell+1)
    (hq : d.reg (r 23) = 2^ell) (hQ : d.reg (r 24) = 2^(2*ell)) :
    ∃ t e, t ≤ 10000*(M+1)^6 ∧
      (ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldArithmetic.multiply r).Stops inp (d.toCfg (ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldArithmetic.multiply (B := B) r).entry) t e ∧
      e.store = ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldArithmetic.multiplyResult r d ∧
      e.reg (r 20) = (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.BinaryField.multiplyIndex ell h m (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.BinaryPolynomial.indexEquiv ell a) (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.BinaryPolynomial.indexEquiv ell b)).val ∧
      (∀ i, i < 2 ∨ i = 3 ∨ i = 19 ∨ i = 23 ∨ i = 24 → e.reg (r i) = d.reg (r i)) ∧
      (∀ j, (∀ i, j ≠ r i) → e.reg j = d.reg j) ∧
      (∀ j, e.reg j ≤ M) ∧ ExpandingCodes.Computation.FieldConvolution.tapeData e.store = ExpandingCodes.Computation.FieldConvolution.tapeData d := by sorry
natural_statement: For an arbitrary encoded monic degree-ell binary modulus, the explicit finite tape program for modular polynomial multiplication halts with exactly the canonical remainder index. It satisfies the stated polynomial time bound and preserves its inputs, unused caller registers, heads, output, and buffers; irreducibility is not assumed.
source: Algorithmic supporting lemma for Section 2 of Isaac M Hair and Amit Sahai, Expanding Codes with Polynomial Stretch; the explicit tape-machine implementation is formalized in ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldArithmetic.
proof_route: The proof connects bounded physical convolution and remainder search to uniqueness of the polynomial remainder, then establishes the preservation conditions.
solution_header:
theorem solution {R B : ℕ} (r : Fin 27 → Fin R) (hr : Function.Injective r)
    (inp : Inputs) (ell : ℕ) (h : 0 < ell) (m a b : Fin (2^ell))
    (M : ℕ) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (d : ExpandingCodes.Computation.TapeStore R B) (hd : ∀ j, d.reg j ≤ M)
    (ha : d.reg (r 0) = a.val) (hb : d.reg (r 1) = b.val)
    (hm : d.reg (r 3) = 2^ell+m.val) (hN : d.reg (r 19) = 3*ell+1)
    (hq : d.reg (r 23) = 2^ell) (hQ : d.reg (r 24) = 2^(2*ell)) :
    ∃ t e, t ≤ 10000*(M+1)^6 ∧
      (ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldArithmetic.multiply r).Stops inp (d.toCfg (ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldArithmetic.multiply (B := B) r).entry) t e ∧
      e.store = ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldArithmetic.multiplyResult r d ∧
      e.reg (r 20) = (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.BinaryField.multiplyIndex ell h m (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.BinaryPolynomial.indexEquiv ell a) (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.BinaryPolynomial.indexEquiv ell b)).val ∧
      (∀ i, i < 2 ∨ i = 3 ∨ i = 19 ∨ i = 23 ∨ i = 24 → e.reg (r i) = d.reg (r i)) ∧
      (∀ j, (∀ i, j ≠ r i) → e.reg j = d.reg j) ∧
      (∀ j, e.reg j ≤ M) ∧ ExpandingCodes.Computation.FieldConvolution.tapeData e.store = ExpandingCodes.Computation.FieldConvolution.tapeData d
solution_body:
by
  exact @ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldArithmetic.multiply_stops R B r hr inp ell h m a b M hM d hd ha hb hm hN hq hQ
